title: Pan Right
description: A pan right shot is a horizontal rotation of a locked-off camera toward the right. It connects two parts of the same geography in one continuous turn from a single station point.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: End on the story beat, not on a wall. The rightward turn can follow a look, a car, or a line of dialogue that points off-screen.

Because the camera does not walk, the ethics of the shot stay those of a witness who can turn but cannot follow. It is the wrong tool for a chase that must match pace, and the wrong tool for a sting that needs motion blur as a cut.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Fluid head, yaw only, horizon level, feathered stop on a composed end frame. Keep exposure in mind if you pan into a window.
Prompt a slow pan right from a locked tripod, fluid head rotation, level horizon, a continuous horizontal reveal.

sections.title: When to use it

blocks.text: Same job as pan left, other direction. End on the story beat.
Concrete beat: a speaker finishes, the pan finds the listener who will decide. Do not overshoot and hunt.

sections.title: In film

blocks.text: There Will Be Blood turns across interiors and landscapes to bind oil, prayer, and land in one station. The Rules of the Game uses fluid pans through the chateau so class and hunting share deep space.
Grammar of the turn, not a layout to copy.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: The usual wrong cousin is a Dolly Right or a Whip Pan that never resolves. The tell is parallax you did not want, or blur that never hard-stops.
The fix: locked sticks, yaw right, level horizon, clean settle.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Pan Right in film?
It is a rightward yaw of the camera on a fixed tripod, sweeping the view horizontally without moving the support.
Pan Right vs Dolly Right
Dolly right relocates the camera on an X axis. Pan right only rotates, so you look at a new part of the same place from the same spot.
When should I use Pan Right?
When the next fact is to the right and a turn is enough to connect it. Do not use it to fake a track along a street.
How do I prompt Pan Right for AI image or video?
Write fixed tripod, pan right, horizontal rotation only, level horizon, no body travel. Name the landing frame.
